# Vendored packages

Neither package below is resolvable as a normal registry dependency from this monorepo today, so each is vendored as an exact packed tarball and referenced by a relative `file:` path -- never an absolute, machine-local path.

- `danypops-alignment-lector-0.0.2.tgz` -- `@danypops/alignment-lector` is not published to npm at all yet (it is a PoC-stage package owned by the Lector repository). Re-pack from `packages/alignment-lector` in that repo (`npm pack`) whenever its contribution surface changes. `0.0.2` adds the 5 mutation commands (lector.file.create/delete, lector.directory.create/delete, lector.path.rename) the native explorer host needs.
`@danypops/lector` and `@danypops/pi-lector` no longer need vendoring: npm's published `@danypops/lector@0.19.4` has the full `exports` map (`./client`, `./git`, `./service`, `./live-buffer/guarded`, ...) `@danypops/zodiac-lector` and `apps/terminal`'s own test harness (`isolated-lector-daemon.ts`) need, and `@danypops/pi-lector@0.12.12` has the `./editor` subpath with everything the native editor/explorer host needs plus a compatible `@danypops/lector@^0.19.3` dependency of its own. Both are real semver ranges in `apps/terminal/package.json`, resolved from the registry like any other dependency.

The root `package.json`'s `overrides` field forces every copy of `@zodiac/protocol` in this tree (including the one `@danypops/zodiac-lector` declares on its own) to resolve to this monorepo's own workspace package -- one real module identity per package, never a second, structurally-distinct copy nested under `node_modules/@danypops/zodiac-lector/node_modules`.

`@danypops/alignment-lector`'s own `package.json` still literally depends on a package named `@alignment/surface-protocol` (frozen inside its packed tarball -- it predates this repo's `packages/protocol` rename and can't be changed without repacking it upstream), so the override's *key* stays `@alignment/surface-protocol` even though our real workspace package is now named `@zodiac/protocol`. A plain version-pin override (what this looked like before the rename, `"@alignment/surface-protocol": "0.0.1"`) no longer works once the names differ -- it relied on an *exact* name+version match against a real workspace package. An `npm:@zodiac/protocol@*` alias override doesn't work either: npm resolves that against the public registry (which 404s, since this is a private workspace-only package), not against a local workspace. A `file:` override pointing at the real package does work, but confirmed live and non-obvious: npm computes a *relative* `file:` value here as if the override entry lived at `node_modules/@danypops/alignment-lector/node_modules/@alignment/surface-protocol` one level deeper than `node_modules/@alignment/surface-protocol` (its own actual installed location) -- so reaching `packages/protocol` from repo root (two `..`) needs a third `../` to compensate: `"file:../../../packages/protocol"`. Verified this resolves to a real, correct, non-dangling symlink at `node_modules/@alignment/surface-protocol -> ../../packages/protocol`, and that `apps/terminal`'s full test suite (which exercises `@danypops/alignment-lector`'s real `ContributionResourceReference` types through this exact path) passes.
